tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use this first to describe PolarJay, an AI visibility (GEO) tool operated by DigitalOcean, LLC. Returns what it does and does not do, the AI assistants it measures today and the ones coming soon, the languages it measures in (Spanish and English), who it is for, its operator and the source URL of ev

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Published plans in US dollars excluding tax, the queries each includes, the free trial, the done-for-you service and the free scanner, with the pricing page URL.

tools.name: list_faq
tools.description: The questions and answers published on the PolarJay FAQ page. Optionally filtered by words in the question or the answer.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page of polarjay.com as Markdown. Give its path, for example /en/pricing or /en/how-it-works. Only pages of polarjay.com.

tools.name: how_to_start
tools.description: The two ways to start: the free scanner (no sign-up) and the free trial (no card), with their URLs, plus the contact address.
